what: A desert cactus: tapered ribbed column with rounded, tapered arms and spine nubs - not three pieces of green plumbing.

dims.basis: target from visual-QA brief; replaces assets/models/cactus.glb

views.why: commander camera at 45/30; gameplay-scale readability is the contract

style_notes: Low-Poly Diorama: chunky, faceted, flat-shaded, palette-only, readable at ~60 px. 1u = 1 tile; player = 1.55u; base at z=0, centred on (0,0). Palette from docs/ART_DIRECTION.md. Never: plain cubes, featureless blobs, smooth normals, textures, invented hues, trees that are just cones/cylinders.
notes: Fresh-eyes visual QA rebuild: bmesh parts, bevels, weighted normals, packed UV0; re-exported to assets/models/cactus.glb.
